paragraphs: Portraits, weddings and product shots, on location or in the studio.

items.title: How long does a session take?
items.description: Most portrait sessions run about an hour.

items.title: Do you travel?
items.description: Yes, within 100 miles of the studio at no extra charge.

items.title: When do I get my photos?
items.description: Within two weeks, through a private online gallery.

items.title: Can I buy prints?
items.description: Yes, prints and albums are available from the gallery.

blocks.title: Monthly news
blocks.description: New work, studio dates and the odd discount. No spam.
